notes.title: New Update Available
notes.notes:
The game has been updated to improve the overall experience: 

-Diagonal movement speed has been reduced to improve the gameplay. Now it's possible to use the rubber screen limit technique for more accurate bullet dodging.
 
-Added 99 credits to smooth the learning curve and make the game more accesible and less frustrating.

-Fixed the invincibility bug.

-Brighter backgrounds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35669471/ddfbd0bc2e7ddc1259cb5507f0ad3f3ad834e3d2.png[/img]

Thanks everyone for your comments!

notes.title: Planet Automata release date has been delayed a few days
notes.notes:
Planet Automata release has been delayed a few days due to a longer submission process than expected. Stay tuned for more information. Meanwhile you can check out the new trailer we have recently published on Youtube and the store featuring the final version of the game.

Please subscribe, comment and share. We need your support to keep it going! :)
